headline: Public docs teardown: highest-impact fixes and the automation layer to prioritize first

summary.executive_summary: Audit of docs.cryptoprocessing.com covered 78 pages with 100% crawl coverage and 91.5% overall confidence. Retrieval readiness scores 84.61/100 (strong band), with 82.21% API reference coverage across 28 detected API pages. Critical gaps: 0% example reliability estimate, 25% SEO/geo issue rate, 50% actionability coverage, and 61.7% evidence coverage (58 of 94 key claims lack supporting evidence). One confirmed broken internal link detected in user-facing docs.

key_findings.headline: Code examples fail or are non-runnable
key_findings.business_consequence: Run smoke + expected-output checks and auto-fix broken snippets.

key_findings.headline: Code/docs contract drift
key_findings.business_consequence: Track interface changes and enforce docs updates with report-first governance.

key_findings.headline: Missing required doc layers
key_findings.business_consequence: Backfill concept/how-to/reference coverage for key capabilities.

priority_actions.title: Instrument and validate all code examples with automated testing or runnable snippets to lift 0% example reliability
priority_actions.why_this_first: Validated examples directly unblock developer onboarding and integration success, the highest-value conversion path for API docs.

priority_actions.title: Add evidence citations or links to 36 unsupported claims (38.3% gap) prioritizing API authentication, payment flows, and security assertions
priority_actions.why_this_first: Evidence gaps on critical claims erode trust and degrade AI-generated answers, directly impacting support deflection and sales confidence.

priority_actions.title: Audit and resolve SEO/geo issues on ~20 pages (25% issue rate), focusing on meta descriptions, canonical tags, and regional access
priority_actions.why_this_first: SEO fixes improve organic discovery and regional reach, expanding top-of-funnel traffic with moderate effort.

strengths: 100% last-updated coverage and 100% answerability/citationability for AI retrieval
82.21% API reference coverage with 28 API pages detected, no detection limitations flagged
Strong overall retrieval readiness band (84.61/100) with 82.05% chunkability
risks: 0% example reliability estimate indicates no validated or testable code examples across 78 pages, blocking developer onboarding
25% SEO/geo issue rate (approximately 20 pages) risks poor discoverability in search and regional access problems
61.7% evidence coverage means 36 of 94 key claims lack citations, reducing trust and AI answer accuracy
50% actionability coverage suggests half the content lacks clear next steps or CTAs, weakening conversion
limitations: External audit cannot verify runtime correctness of code examples or API endpoint behavior; 0% reliability estimate reflects lack of test instrumentation, not execution validation.
SEO/geo issue detection covers technical signals (meta tags, structure) but cannot measure actual search ranking, click-through rates, or regional performance without analytics integration.
Evidence coverage identifies claims without citations but cannot assess the accuracy, relevance, or authority of provided sources.
automation_first: Deploy CI-integrated example testing (e.g., doctest, runnable notebooks) to validate code snippets on every commit, addressing the 0% example reliability across all detected examples and preventing outdated code from reaching production docs.

Implement automated broken link scanning in pre-deploy pipeline to catch the 1 confirmed broken internal link type issue before publish, with Slack alerts for any new failures, reducing manual QA overhead and trust damage.

Add evidence-coverage linter to flag claims lacking citations during content review, targeting the 36 unsupported claims (38.3% gap) and ensuring new content meets evidence standards before merge, improving AI answer quality and reducing post-publish rework.
